attributes.name: Tricks for Treats
attributes.description:
Solo Compulsories

3 chosen maneuvers are performed with no music. Skaters are grouped by age and level. Connecting steps are limited and not judged. Maneuvers may only be performed once, in any order, with no additional maneuvers allowed. 

Jump and Spin

2 skaters enter the ice as a team. The first skater performs the choice of a desired jump two times, followed by the second skater performing the choice of a required spin two times. Only the best attempt at each maneuver will be scored.

  • Low: Tiny Tots-Intermediate 2
  • Bronze: Int 3-Adv.2
  • Silver: Adv. 3-5


Halloween Costumes are encouraged
Register online & submit paper entry form to front desk by 10/10/26
No refunds or credits
